name: Leather Belt
description: A plain leather belt with iron buckle. Holds pouches and scabbards.

name: Adventurer's Belt
description: A wide belt with multiple loops and pouches for quick-draw access. Boosts the potency of all skills.

name: Ogre Girdle
description: A thick, heavy girdle fashioned from ogre leather and reinforced with iron plates. Its brutal weight grants the wearer exceptional resilience.

name: Crocodile Hide Belt
description: A broad belt cut from the armoured hide of a crocodile warrior, its scutes still hard as iron. The relentless vigour of the swamp-stalker keeps the wearer wading on through any mire.

name: Colossus Girdle
description: A massive girdle reinforced with iron bands torn from a giant's own war-club. Braced about the waist, it lends the strength of mountains and an unshakable nerve.
